fat_pct.quote: The average of the fat in dry matter (FDM) of the cheeses was 51.9% with a standard deviation of 0.7%.

salt_pct.quote: brine salted to a content of around 1.2% in the cheese

ammonia.reason: Limited amino-acid deamination in waxed low-moisture interior without surface flora; pH rise only to ~5.6.

animal_barnyard.reason: Low p-cresol/indole from Tyr/Trp catabolism in pasteurized milk without smear flora.

bitter.reason: Hydrophobic alpha-s1-casein peptides from mesophilic Lactococcus proteinases with low 1.2% salt masking.

blue_moldy.reason: No Penicillium roqueforti; only low background 2-heptanone/2-nonanone from lipolysis.

browning.reason: Low residual lactose but high free amino acids from 14-mo proteolysis drive moderate Maillard on heating.

buttery.reason: Diacetyl/acetoin from citrate metabolism by Leuconostoc in DL-starter, partly volatilized by long >40C cooking.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Butyric/hexanoic acids from milk lipase and NSLAB lipolysis accumulating over long ripening.

creaminess.reason: Extra-hard 32% moisture matrix with crystalline texture gives little melt-in-mouth fat creaminess.

crumbliness.reason: Long proteolysis plus tyrosine/calcium-lactate crystals fracture low-moisture cooked curd.

firmness.reason: Hours cooking above 40C with extensive syneresis and pressing to 32% moisture in 18-kg cylinders.

floral_honey.reason: Phenylacetaldehyde/2-phenylethanol from phenylalanine catabolism by lactococci during extended aging.

fruity.reason: Ethyl butanoate/hexanoate from esterification of fatty acids by lactococcal/NSLAB esterases, key flavour.

goaty.reason: Cow milk only, no goat branched C8-C10 4-methyl/4-ethyloctanoic acids; only low lipolysis background.

malty_nutty.reason: Strecker 2-/3-methylbutanal from Leu/Ile/Val catabolism plus long-cook Maillard pyrazines.

melt.reason: Aged pH-5.6 low-moisture rennet network softens and oils but shows poor flow.

mushroom_earthy.reason: No mold-derived 1-octen-3-ol pathway; waxed interior allows only trace lipid oxidation.

oil_off.reason: 33% fat in contracted cooked curd releases free oil on heating, moderated by aged emulsifying peptides.

smoky.reason: No smoking step; no guaiacol/syringol phenols.

sour_vinegar.reason: Acetic acid from heterofermentative Leuconostoc citrate metabolism, buffered at pH ~5.6.

stretch.reason: No pasta-filata hot-water kneading; aged calcium-crosslinked curd cannot align.

sulfur_cooked.reason: DMS/DMDS/DMTS from Lactococcus methionine demethiolation plus long hot-cook sulfhydryl note.

sweet.reason: Lactose depleted; mild sweetness from free Pro/Ala and glycerol balanced by bitter/salt.

umami.reason: Very high free glutamate from 14-mo chymosin/plasmin plus Lactococcus peptidase proteolysis.
